Net order value is quantity × unit price × (1 − discount rate); only Completed orders count as net revenue.

- **q1:** March completed orders total **£13,704.50**.
- **q2:** Q2 net revenue by region: North **£9,538.50**, East £9,178.25, South £7,377.00, West £4,317.50. North was highest.
- **q3:** Standing Desk net revenue rose from **£6,300.00** in Q1 to **£13,188.00** in Q2. Growth = (£13,188 − £6,300) ÷ £6,300 × 100 = **109.3%**.
- **q4:** Discount-adjusted value of refunded and cancelled orders from January to June was **£10,843.50**.
- **q5:** Brookside Dental had the highest January–June net revenue, **£8,826.75**.
- **q6:** Q1 net revenue was £47,122.35 across 64 completed orders, giving an average of **£736.29**.
